formulas.K1_0: sigma0*sqrt(pi*L)  [= sqrt(pi*L) per unit loading; time-independent for loading 1]
formulas.V1_short_coeff: A = sigma0*16*(nu_u-nu)/sqrt(pi) * L^2/G  in  V ~ V1_0 + A*sqrt(c*t/L^2)
formulas.p_faces_0: sigma0*2*(nu_u-nu)/(alpha*(1-2*nu))  (undrained pore pressure at the faces)
formulas.K2_0: 0  (no traction applied; undrained response is identically zero)
formulas.K2_inf: 0  (t->inf state: p = 1 uniform, sigma = 0; crack neither opens nor loads tips)
formulas.V2_inf: 0  (uniform strain alpha*(1-2*nu)/(2G) everywhere; zero-thickness slit does not open)
